## Three pairs go back

- **R2, batch 8** — two of fifteen Conrad §6 declines name homes that don't exist in `plan-spec.json`, and both are 3–4 line corollaries of theorems *on that page*: Thm 6.6 from item 29 (Cauchy–Frobenius), Thm 6.10 from item 17 (normalizer count). 6.9's reason ("not consumed here") isn't a permitted ground. Everything else landed. **Beta-8's one disagreement is upheld** — my suggested citation would have been a forward edge into a B-page leaf (order 45 from 43); my original suggestion was wrong on the orders.
- **R3, batch 9 / gaussian** — A page is a complete standard chapter, no additions asked. B page has no witness for the *explicit* "over an infinite field" hypothesis (over 𝔽₂, `x+y=0` has exactly two solutions). Plus disposition rows for LU and the rank normal form, which appear in no source's `contents` at all.
- **R4, batch 9 / determinants** — one B item (det is not additive; the page has no witness for multilinearity's boundary and is the run's only B page with no false-statement), plus a decline naming the nonexistent page `invertibility-and-adjugate`.

The ring-versus-field boundary you asked me to check is **right**. The cofactor/adjugate/Cramer deferral is licensed by the plan, not invented — order 84 is literally titled *"The Determinant of a Linear Operator, Cofactors and Cramer's Rule"*.

## One blocker that belongs to you, not a Beta

**R1 — the re-home breaks the destination page's `requires` closure.** The receipt verified the moved items' dependency *orders* (5.3–24 < 46). `validate-plan.mjs` also enforces `undeclared-prereq` against the **transitive closure of declared `requires`**, and `rings-subrings-and-integral-domains` declares only `divisibility-gcd-and-bezout`, whose 12-page closure omits `finite-counting-and-binomial-coefficients` (order 20) — home of `def-finite-cardinality`, `def-sum-over-a-finite-index-set`, `thm-product-rule`, `thm-sum-rule`. Four errors the moment the re-home lands. One-line fix, but `frontier-10-splice.mjs` unions `requires` for in-run pages only, so it won't do it itself.

The receipt's two open follow-ups both came back clear: no forward wikilinks in either moved item, no positional prose falsified.

Also: my first-pass summary line said "five sufficient, seven insufficient" — the table said four and eight, and the table is right. Same pairs either way; the count just shouldn't be quoted.
